provenance.fresh_worker_launch_and_no_reload: operator attested; one Ready line per worker and no reload/error lines observed; no post-run loaded-bundle measurement

metric_semantics.firstDeltaMs: Client time to parsing first semantic text delta, after fetch and incremental client decoding/parsing.
metric_semantics.terminalMs: Client time to parsing the response terminal frame, including client parsing; separate from provider termination or background completion.
metric_semantics.eofMs: Recorded after reader done, decoder finalization, full independent oracle execution and row preparation. Includes client validation; not exact body EOF.
metric_semantics.clientReadCount: Client reads from gateway response, not gateway reads from upstream.
metric_semantics.quantiles: p50 uses arithmetic median of middle two values; p95 uses nearest rank ceil(0.95*n). Per-block n=12 makes p95 the maximum.
metric_semantics.paired_comparison: Differences of A/B within-block cell medians and separate medians/distributions of adjacent per-request B-A differences; neither is a confidence interval.

pilot_counter_review.limits: Counter-clone measurements prove only successful-path API operation counts and C separation in that pilot. They do not prove retained-listener absence, cancellation correctness or main-run transport read distributions.

findings: At N=256 with C=1 or C=16, all eight block/cell terminal medians are higher in B by 1.120 to 2.317 ms. At C=256 the B-A high-N contrast changes sign across blocks.

The N256-N1 change in B-A terminal medians is positive in 11 of 12 block/C contrasts, but intermediate N=16 is not monotonically ordered in every contrast; no uniform linear per-frame effect is established.

C=256 minus C=1 raises terminal medians in both variants by approximately 23.4 to 31.7 ms despite no configured per-frame sleeps; this is local client/fixture/HTTP/runtime cost, not isolated gateway billed CPU.
Response bytes vary with N (108924/109236/114438) despite fixed upstream bytes; padding position and renderer/client work remain confounders.
No evidence here authorizes removing either StreamTail layer or changing cancellation, late-error, terminal, persistence or retry semantics.
gaps: Twelve-request unpadded sensitivity did not run before interruption.
Raw shell exit-code receipt is absent; no rerun is justified solely to manufacture it.
Raw semantic events/wire captures are not retained, so the reviewer can audit oracle source and logged verdict consistency but cannot replay the full semantic oracle independently.
No exact reader-done timestamp; eofMs includes independent client oracle execution.
Main has no gateway read counters; C separation observed in count pilot is not measured in later timing workers.
No separately recorded workerd binary hash/version or loaded-bundle identity measurement.
No CPU Inspector profile, cloud billed CPU measurement, retained-heap/native-memory measurement or capture-on coverage in this frame run.
Cancellation, late errors, hung next, cleanup ownership, multibyte UTF-8 and split-CRLF correctness remain outside the successful LF/ASCII fixture.
Local concurrency-one finite run does not validate production mixed-load resource or one-hour soak gates.
